title: Answer: consciousness is introspective subjectivity that misrepresents itself as phenomenal

statements.text: Consciousness, in the sense in which it exists, is having sensory states that introspective mechanisms represent, and in that functional sense experiences are like something. Those mechanisms misrepresent the states as having phenomenal properties, so phenomenal consciousness proper is an illusion.

sources.quote: We might call this introspective subjectivity.
